proposal.updated.max_rate: 1 per proposal per 3 s, pending only
proposal.updated.why: quote refresh is routine; a push or toast would be noise. 1.1.5: a refresh does NOT bump rev (push tokens stay valid), it sets a new quote_id. Client: merge quote fields; if quoteChanged(prev, next) (quote_id differs) show the inline label only while the review sheet is open, and if a Real hold is in progress cancel it first, then render, then show hold_reset_key. Real approve sends expected_quote_id (Practice ignores it). A rev change still means the proposal itself changed (VERSION_CONFLICT handling)
